name: scroll-based-velocity
description: Two opposing display-type rows that crawl sideways and surge when the page is scrolled.
purpose: Turns a short campaign phrase into a kinetic band whose speed tracks scroll so a landing page feels physically tied to the reader.
bestFor: section breaks between hero and features
studio sites that want a kinetic type strip
avoidFor: forms or task UI where moving type would compete with controls
